Sources, terms
and provenance.

The first route draws on existing case texts. These sources support checking and further reading.

Learn Git: books, courses and official introductions

The Editionskompass adds editorial decision-making to technical introductions. We recommend the following resources for learning the tools. Languages are indicated; links lead to publisher or provider pages. Books may require purchase.

Books

  • Head First Git
    Raju Gandhi · O’Reilly · 2022 · EN

    Our special recommendation for beginners, including those without programming knowledge: all examples use text files in Git-managed folders. No programming language or specialist technical knowledge is needed. Behind the colourful, sometimes noisy design is a carefully structured route explaining both how and why.

  • Git. Projektverwaltung für Entwickler und DevOps-Teams
    Bernd Öggl, Michael Kofler · Rheinwerk · 3. Auflage / edition · 2025 · DE

    Our recommendation for a comprehensive German-language handbook covering the entire Git ecosystem. Many practical tips and techniques make it valuable beyond the initial introduction. Despite its scope, it is clearly structured for learning. Its examples are more firmly rooted in software development.

  • Git for Teams
    Emma Jane Hogbin Westby · O’Reilly · 2015 · EN

    A goldmine for organising teamwork with Git. Transfer its software-industry examples to editorial work to find valuable ideas about roles, collaboration, shared rules and workflows. Its age does little to diminish this organisational value; check technical instructions against current documentation.

  • Pro Git
    Scott Chacon, Ben Straub · Apress · 2. Auflage / edition · 2014 · DE / EN

    Freely readable online, including a German translation. Suitable for a systematic introduction and later reference; the online edition receives additions and corrections.

Official documentation, videos and a course

  • Git Tutorial · EN

    Official introduction: start tracking a project, save changes and share them.

  • Git User’s Manual · EN

    Official manual for a fuller introduction and reference.

  • Git · Videos · EN

    Short introductory videos on the official Git website.

  • Software Carpentry · Version Control with Git · EN

    An openly available, exercise-based course for researchers: changes, collaboration, conflicts and open science.

  • GitHub · What is GitHub? · EN

    Official platform introduction, also explaining the relationship between GitHub and Git.

Bibliographic details and links checked on 27 October 2026.

Further documentation
